learn_source: Watch the herbalist lay cut herbs by for the festival week in the Town scene — tonic ingredients gathered early must still be good on rite night
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on something freshly cut or picked once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the hold lasts the whole festival week; at baseline it buys a day or two. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: Stay fresh past their time — stems firm, petals unbrowned
no_effect — already past fresh; there is nothing left to hold
State-dependent: just-picked, the berries hold at ripe; already turning, the soft ones stay soft — the hold is not a rewind
No physical effect — living receivers never catch; nothing is held
receivers.reaction_kind: slow blink, walks through the cast point unbothered
long look at the caster — she keeps things her own way
